summary.content:
Today's selection covers 62 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 38 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Remediating Vulnerabilities With LLMs: Inside Ivanti's Automation Push
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Attackers Combo Up Evasion Tactics for BEC Phishing
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 45 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Remediating Vulnerabilities With LLMs: Inside Ivanti's Automation Push
top.description: Ivanti CSO Daniel Spicer says frontier models have shown surprising effectiveness in early stages; but cost and human-in-the-loop viability remain open questions.
